_help: Edit this file to change route descriptions or legend groups. Descriptions are keyed by route number. Group default: on, off, or sundays (on only on Sundays). The site rebuilds after you commit. The ridership block sets the ArcGIS Online layer the stop ridership charts come from, and where 'Explore the stops dashboard' links to.

routes.1: Downtown Burlington to Williston Walmart via Williston Road, UVM, University Mall and Market Street.
routes.2: Downtown Burlington to the Essex Junction Amtrak station via Colchester Avenue, Winooski and Pearl Street.
routes.4: Weekday loop from the Essex Junction Amtrak station via the Essex Outlets, Center Road and River Road.
routes.5: Downtown Burlington to the South End via Pine Street.
routes.6: Downtown Burlington to the Shelburne Museum via Shelburne Road.
routes.7: Downtown Burlington to the New North End via North Avenue.
routes.8: Loop from downtown Burlington through the Old North End, Fern Hill and McAuley Square.
routes.9: Downtown Burlington to Winooski via Riverside Avenue, with a loop through Winooski.
routes.11: Downtown Burlington to South Burlington via Main Street, Dorset Street, Kennedy Drive and Market Street.
routes.16: Tuesday shopping trip from Pillsbury Manor, The Pines and Country Park to Hannaford at University Mall.
routes.19: Thursday shopping trip from Burlington senior housing to Market 32.
routes.20: Wednesday shopping trip from Winooski and Burlington senior housing to Market 32.
routes.86: Downtown Burlington to Montpelier via I-89, stopping in Williston, Richmond and Waterbury.
routes.96: Downtown Burlington to St. Albans via US 7 and I-89, serving Winooski, Colchester, Milton and Georgia.
routes.756: Sunday loop from downtown Burlington through the South End via Pine Street and Shelburne Road.
routes.778: Sunday loop from downtown Burlington through the North End via North Avenue.

trip_costs._help: Used for 'Save about $X vs. driving' in the trip planner. Update gas_price (and gas_price_as_of) every few months. Per-mile costs are cents per mile.
trip_costs.maintenance_source: AAA Your Driving Costs 2025, small sedan (maintenance, repair and tires)
trip_costs.depreciation_source: Estimate of the extra loss in a used compact car's value from added miles
trip_costs.fare_note: $2.00 per ride, no free transfers; $4.00 daily cap with the Genfare Link app (GMT 2024 Urban Fare Plan)
trip_costs.mpg_source: 2021 statewide average fuel economy of Vermont's light-duty vehicles (Vermont energy planning data from VTrans and partners)

frequency_overrides._help: Routes that run at a set frequency all day, in minutes. Wherever such a route runs, the frequency map shows at least that often (combined with other routes on the same street).

amenity_overrides._help: Amenities set for stops whose name contains this text, whatever the stop survey says.
